subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Sandbagging Forecasts
description: Learn Sandbagging Forecasts in one minute.

hook.text: A manager forecasts 80 units knowing demand is 100. Beating the target looks great at bonus time.

buildup.text: Sandbagging means intentionally under-forecasting so that actual results exceed the plan.

discovery.text: It makes the manager look good but causes the supply chain to understock and miss real demand.

twist.text: The incentive system causes the problem. If bonuses reward beating forecasts, people game the numbers.

climax.text: Fixing sandbagging requires rewarding forecast accuracy, not forecast beats. Change the metric, change the behavior.

punchline.text: Reward accuracy, not sandbagging. Incentives drive behavior.

quiz.question: Why do managers sandbag forecasts?
options: To beat low targets and earn bonuses
